state.title: Add GET /invoices list endpoint
state.description: New endpoint to list invoices for the current organization with pagination and date filtering.

state.title: Add due_date to Invoice model
state.description: Adds a due_date column so invoices can be soted by when payment is owed.

state.title: Support attaching receipts to invoices
state.description: Lets users upload a receipt image that gets stored on S3 and linked to the invoice.

state.title: Add management command to backfill invoice totals
state.description: New command backfill_invoice_totals that recomputes and stores the cached total_amount for existing invoices. Also fixes a rounding issue in the new field.

state.title: Add email notification preference per user
state.description: Store whether each user wants marketing emails or not.

state.title: Add index on Invoice.organization_id
state.description: Speed up listing invoices by organization.

state.title: Add incoming webhook endpoint for payment events
state.description: New POST /webhooks/payments endpoint that parse the payment provider payload.

state.title: Add invoice status field with mark-paid endpoint
state.description: Adds a status field and an endpoint to mark an invoice as paid.

state.title: Backfill subscription tiers for existing organizations
state.description: Data migration that assigns a default tier to organizations created before tiers existed, plus a new tier field on the model.

state.title: Allow filtering invoices by payment status
state.description: Adds a status query param and indexes the status column for faster filtering.

state.title: Verify payment webhook signatures
state.description: Adds HMAC signature verification to the payment webhook so we reject forged events. The shared secret comes from settings.

state.title: Add Organization model with memberships
state.description: We introduce organization and membership table with the basic CRUD endpoint.

state.title: Add API key generation and revocation endpoints
state.description: Users can create and revoke personal API keys for programmatic access.

state.title: Add role field with fine-grained permissions
state.description: Introduces a role field and a permission-check helper used by several endpoints to control who can edit.

state.title: Add audit log table
state.description: New AuditEntry model that records who did what, with a management command to prune old entries.

state.title: Add endpoint to download invoice PDFs
state.description: Streams a generated PDF of an invoice to the client. The filename is read from the URL.

state.title: Fix crash when uploading receipt with empty filename
state.description: The receipt upload endpoint raised a 500 when the client sent an empty filename. We now reject it with a 400.

state.title: Fix wrong default value on Invoice.currency
state.description: The previous migration set currency to USD but the code assumed empty. Add a follow-up migration to fix the default.

state.title: Fix login returning 500 for locked accounts
state.description: The JWT login endpoint crashed when the account was locked. It now returns a clear error message.

state.title: Refactor invoice total calculation
state.description: Extract the total calculation into a helper. The old code added tax twice, which is fixed by this change.

state.title: Fix flaky test in notification scheduler
state.description: The test used the current time so it failed near midnight. Freeze the clock in the test only.

state.title: Stop returning password hash in user serializer
state.description: The user detail endpoint accidentally included the password hash field. Remove it from the response schema.

state.title: Fix orphaned invoices missing organization_id
state.description: Some invoices were created before the organization field existed. Data migration assigns them to the default org.

state.title: Fix users able to view other organizations' invoices
state.description: The list endpoint did not scope the queryset to the user's organization. Add the missing filter.

state.title: Fix unique constraint on Invoice.number
state.description: The number field was missing its unique constraint in the latest migration. Add it back.

state.title: Fix SQL injection in report filter
state.description: The report endpoint interpolated the raw sort column into SQL. Use the mapped column list instead.

state.title: Fix refresh token accepted after logout
state.description: Refresh tokens stayed valid after the user logged out because we did not check the token version.

state.title: Fix pagination off-by-one on invoice list
state.description: The last item was dropped when the page size divided the total evenly.

state.title: Fix missing default tier on legacy organizations
state.description: Legacy organizations got a null tier and the API crashed. Backfill a default tier.

state.title: Extract invoice query logic into InvoiceQuery service
state.description: Move the queryset-building code out of the controller into a dedicated service class.

state.title: Move status choices out of the model
state.description: Refactor invoice status from a model choices tuple into a separate constants module. Includes a migration because the choice ordering changed.

state.title: Move schema files into a schemas subpackage
state.description: Reorganize the billing schemas into a package without changing them.

state.title: Extract token validation into a helper
state.description: Move the duplicated JWT validation logic into a shared helper. No behavior change.

state.title: Simplify invoice queryset filtering
state.description: Replace a long if/elif chain with Q objects; same results.

state.title: Rename Invoice.amount to total_amount
state.description: Rename the field for clarity. Includes a migration that keeps the data.

state.title: Centralize user input sanitization
state.description: Move the HTML-escaping of user-supplied note fields into one helper used everywhere. Same behavior, less duplication.

state.title: Consolidate duplicate user schemas
state.description: Two apps defined nearly identical user schemas. Merge them into one.

state.title: Split settings into base and local modules
state.description: Move local-only settings into a separate module to make production config clearer.

state.title: Add index while tidying invoice model
state.description: While cleaning up the model Meta, add the missing index on customer_email.

state.title: Extract API key hashing into a helper
state.description: Move the key hashing code into a shared function so it can be reused. No behavior change.

state.title: Update README with setup instructions
state.description: Add local dev setup steps and mention the new uv workflow.

state.title: Fix typo in comment in invoice_service.py
state.description: Fix a spelling mistake in a code comment: 'reciept' to 'receipt'.

state.title: Add API guide for invoice endpoints
state.description: Document the invoice endpoints with request and response examples.

state.title: Update changelog for v2.4
state.description: List the changes in the upcoming release.

state.title: Document how authentication tokens work
state.description: Explain token lifetimes and rotation in the developer guide. No code changes.

state.title: Update deploy.md with migration step
state.description: Add a reminder to run migrations after each deploy.

state.title: Add docstrings to billing services
state.description: Add module and function docstrings throughout the billing app.

state.title: Update CONTRIBUTING with commit conventions
state.description: Document the Conventional Commits rules and PR checklist.

state.title: Rewrite password reset guide
state.description: Rewrite the password reset walkthrough with clearer screenshots and steps.

state.title: Add Django 5 upgrade guide
state.description: Notes for upgrading from Django 4 to 5, including breaking changes.

state.title: Run tests on pull requests
state.description: Add a CI step that runs the test suite and ruff on every PR.

state.title: Bump PyJWT to 2.9.0
state.description: Update the JWT library to the latest release which fixes a token parsing issue.

state.title: Enable more ruff rules
state.description: Turn on additional ruff rules and fix the resulting violations.

state.title: Pin security-scanner image in CI
state.description: Pin the version of the third-party security scanner Docker image used in CI so builds are reproducible. This only pins a tool version; it does not change application security.

state.title: Upgrade cryptography to 42.0.0
state.description: Update the cryptography dependency to the latest major version.

state.title: Bump django-ninja-jwt to 1.1.0
state.description: Update the JWT integration package to the newest release.

state.title: Remove hardcoded secret from Dockerfile
state.description: The Dockerfile had a default API key baked in. Read it from an environment variable instead.

state.title: Rename billing app label in settings
state.description: Update the app label in INSTALLED_APPS and add a migration to update existing content type records to the new label.

state.title: Bump Django to 5.1 for new password hasher
state.description: Upgrade Django to 5.1, which adds the new Argon2id password hasher defaults.

state.title: Enable Postgres full-text search
state.description: Switch the search backend to Postgres FTS. Add a SearchVector index via migration and wire the settings.
